title: ci: let a covered push run borrow the merge queue's verdict
body:
Fixes #31519

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`main` 的 push 运行先读合并队列的结论。本次 push 的每个提交，如果都在自己的第一父提交上有一次全绿的队列运行，push 运行就只跑 main 专属的作业，其余的测试从队列借用结论；只要缺一个、红一个或基不对，就照旧跑全套。
- 为什么改：897 次 push 运行里有 896 次在重测队列刚刚测过的同一棵树，每次大约 260 分钟的 runner 时间。
- 风险与回滚：默认关闭——读不到、读错或结论不全都算"未覆盖"，push 照跑全套；每 4 小时的定时运行仍是完整测试；发布门禁通过队列运行重新读取借用的结论。回滚就是 revert 这一个 PR。
- 先看：`.github/workflows/ci.yml` 顶部新增的两个作业（`queue-verdict`、`Borrowed queue verdict`），以及 `scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs` 里的 HALF 4。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs --self-test` 与 `node scripts/check-shard-attestation.mjs --self-test` 都应 exit 0；"queue verdict: the push probe" 一组里包含下文三个故意制造的红例。
- 需要你做的：审阅后手动合并（Tier H）。

## What changes

- **`queue-verdict` job** (push only, sparse checkout of `scripts/`): `scheduled-full-run.mjs --queue-verdict --before --after` lists the pushed commits (cap 20) and reads, for each one, the newest `merge_group` run of `ci.yml` on that commit. The push is **covered** only when every commit's deciding queue run concluded `success` and was built on the commit's first parent. It writes `covered`, `runs` and `ui_full_green` to `GITHUB_OUTPUT` and a verdict paragraph to the step summary. A read failure or an empty push is `covered=false`.
- **`Borrowed queue verdict` job** (`if: ${{ success() && needs.queue-verdict.outputs.covered == 'true' }}`): the per-merge verdict the release gate reads by name. It runs the affected-test selector against `HEAD^1` and answers `test_ui=skip` only when the head's queue run selected the whole Test UI suite and all 16 shards passed (design note Q2 = B).
- **Covered pushes skip** the jobs whose verdict is borrowed. Every skip reads `needs.queue-verdict.outputs.covered != 'true'`, so a missing or garbled output runs the job (fail closed). The three aggregates (`test-gate`, `dogfood-gate`, `test-ui-gate`) carry `if: always() && needs.queue-verdict.outputs.covered != 'true'`; `build-docs`, `build-e2e-ui` and `live-e2e-ui` carry the covered conjunct; `test-ui` also needs `test_ui != 'skip'`.
- **Seed-only legs** (design note Q1 = A): on a covered push the Test Core and dogfood shards still run to save their Turbo seeds, but exit early on `OS_SEED_ONLY` before their slice build and test step. Their attestation pairs are guarded off.
- **Release gate** (`release.yml` comment, `scheduled-full-run.mjs` HALF 3): a borrowed push run is re-read through the head's queue run. An unread borrow record is `pending` and refused, never a pass.
- **`ui/scripts/test-file-timings.mjs`**: `selectRuns` reads schedule runs only, since a covered push no longer runs every Test UI shard.
- **Docs**: the AGENTS.md "Two speeds" sentence and a new paragraph in `docs/agents/multi-agent-discipline.md`.

No required context is removed: every required check still reports on every push, as a pass or a skip that its aggregate reads.

## Why

The push run of `main` re-tests the tree the merge queue just passed (896 of 897 measured runs), at about 260 runner-minutes each. The queue already ran that exact tree green on that exact base, so the push run can borrow the verdict. It keeps a per-merge verdict for the release gate, and it keeps the cache seeds. The 4-hourly schedule stays the full battery, and no test is skipped on a SHA the queue did not run green.

## Where the build differs from the design note (6722126387)

- **(a) Lint UI runs on a covered push.** Its Turbo seed saves on `push` only, not on `schedule`, so skipping it would starve the seed.
- **(b) A seed-only Test Core leg seeds the closure and holds no test results.** `prune-turbo-cache.mjs` is unchanged; a seed-only leg passes the closure's summary directory as `--run-summaries`.
- **(c) Dogfood Regression Gate skips on a covered push**, while Dogfood Verify CLI's own conclusion stands.
- **(d) `check-shard-attestation.mjs` admits exactly two spellings** (the borrowed gate `if:` and the seed-only credential guard), with an 8-case battery.
- **The seed-only exits read `OS_SEED_ONLY`** instead of a step `if:`, because dispatch-gates' LIVE case "names the invocation itself" reads the dogfood test step and a step `if:` broke it.
- **AGENTS.md re-wrap:** the paragraph from "**Green means**" through Main-red is re-wrapped, with every word outside the "Two speeds" sentence byte-identical, to stay inside the file's 1050-line and 120-byte line budget. The lines are in the claim surface.
- **Files admitted by claim amendment:** `scripts/check-aggregator-roster.mjs` (6 self-test anchors only), `.github/workflows/ui-test-timings-refresh.yml` (2 prose lines only), and `ui/scripts/__tests__/turbo-cache-save-bound.test.ts` (one assertion and its comment).

## Tests

- `scheduled-full-run.mjs --self-test`: new battery "queue verdict: the push probe" (17 cases) and "release gate: a borrowed push verdict" (15 cases). The battery floor goes from 9 to 11.
- `check-shard-attestation.mjs --self-test`: new battery "#31519 a borrowed push: the gate skip and the seed-only credential guard" (8 cases). The floor goes from 24 to 25.
- `ui/scripts/__tests__/test-file-timings.test.ts`: a `selectRuns` case (17 pass). `turbo-cache-save-bound.test.ts`: 46 pass.
- **Three deliberate reds** through `runQueueVerdict` on a 3-commit push, each turning a covered push into a full run:
  - **missing queue run**: "no merge_group run of the workflow is on cccccccccc", so `covered=false`.
  - **red queue run**: "queue run 601 on bbbbbbbbbb concluded failure", so `covered=false`.
  - **wrong base**: "queue run 500 on aaaaaaaaaa was built on dddddddddd, not on the commit's first parent bbbbbbbbbb", so `covered=false`.
  - The control (all three green on their parents) reads `covered=true`.
- **Ablations**: removing each guard (missing, red, wrong base, and the release gate reading an unread record as a full verdict) makes `--self-test` exit 1; restored, it exits 0.

## Verification

All at head 80eca7dc (origin/main 8c75f837 merged), after a full `pnpm build` (exit 0):

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 83 derived gate commands, each run with its exit code recorded before any pipe. **83 of 83 exit 0.**
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran ran.list`: "83 derived famil(ies) accounted for, 83 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero)", exit 0.
- That sweep caught one red the earlier sweep could not: the AGENTS.md re-wrap had split `Dogfood Regression Gate` across two lines, and `check:required-contexts` matches the literal by substring. Fixed in 80eca7dc; the gate is green in the 83.
- ESLint (`--no-inline-config`) on the changed root scripts and the changed `ui/scripts` files: exit 0.
- `git merge-tree` against PR #31429's head 65cf47ab and against current `origin/main`: clean.

Serial: PR #31429 (devx#3) also edits ci.yml; merge-tree clean at 65cf47ab; whichever lands second merges main

Size: 11 files, +1206 / -87 (under 3000 lines). Tier H (`ci.yml`, `release.yml`, `AGENTS.md`): the maintainer merges it by hand.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (not touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; ESLint passes on every changed script (the full `pnpm lint` tree was not run).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. (nothing publishes: `skip-changeset`)
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
